architecture_overview.frontend: React with TypeScript, bundled by Vite

design_system.ui_components: Shadcn UI (built on top of Radix UI primitives)
design_system.themes: Next Themes (supports Dark Mode, Light Mode, and System preferences)
design_system.typography: Tailwind Typography plugin for rich text formatting
philosophy: Utility-first CSS using Tailwind for rapid styling.
Accessible, unstyled components via Radix UI, styled consistently using Shadcn.
Consistent spacing, color variables (CSS Variables defined in global CSS), and rounded corners.

state_and_data_management.server_state_data_fetching: TanStack React Query (Handles caching, synchronization, and background updates)

forms_and_validation.form_handling: React Hook Form (Performant, flexible, and extensible forms with easy-to-use validation)
forms_and_validation.integration: @hookform/resolvers (Connects Zod schema to React Hook Form)

how_to_use_this_blueprint: 1. Use 'npm create vite@latest' to start the React/TypeScript base.
2. Install Tailwind CSS and configure it.
3. Run 'npx shadcn@latest init' to setup the base UI component system.
4. Add complex animation libraries (Framer Motion, GSAP, Lenis) if the new site needs a highly dynamic feel.
5. Use Zustand for state and React Query for API calls to keep the frontend fast and maintainable.
